data.body: Gerrit change 2408 (patchset 2) is now LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, submittable with zero unresolved comments (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2408). Patchset 1's LLM-Review flagged 1 blocking + 6 advisory findings; all addressed in patchset 2: (1) BLOCKING - added tests/interfaces/contracts/test_operation_snapshot_authoritative_binding.py::test_mcp_tool_registered_through_the_proxy_binds_a_snapshot (+ its async counterpart) that actually register a fake MCP tool through bind_operation_snapshot_for_tools and observe active_snapshot() bound inside the handler and unbound after. (2) Fixed a real correctness bug the review surfaced: tracker_dir(root=None) was re-resolving repo_root(root) fresh even with a bound snapshot, so a frozen relative tracker-dir NAME could still be joined against a freshly-moved root if REBAR_ROOT/CWD changed mid-operation - proven RED first via a new test (test_tracker_dir_root_is_frozen_too_not_just_the_configured_name), then fixed by anchoring to the bound snapshot's own repo_root. (3) Normalized tracker.dir access to a hard index (snapshot.values['tracker']['dir']) for consistency with tickets_branch/tickets_remote, since a composed snapshot's values always have this structure. (4) Added a DEBUG-level exc_info log alongside the existing redacted WARNING in compose_and_bind_operation_snapshot's except-Exception, so an operator can diagnose an unexpected composition bug without weakening the fail-open guarantee. (5) Corrected docs/architecture.md and docs/reuse-surface.md, which described the shadow snapshot as universally diagnostic-only across CLI/MCP/library/command surfaces; they now describe the authoritative binding this ticket adds and narrow the diagnostic-shadow description to the surfaces that still deliberately use it (_mcp_llm, _lib_ops, the reconciler entry point). All fixes validated: make lint, make typecheck fully green; the full test_operation_snapshot_authoritative_binding.py suite (now 12 tests) plus all previously-touched test files green; Gerrit's own Verified+1 (full multi-OS/version pytest matrix + integration tier) is the final confirmation. Proceeding to close and land.
